page.overview:
Who is Akhmen-hotep?

Priest King Akhmen-hotep was once the ruler of Ka-Sabar,.

In -1744 IC on the Western Trade Road, near the Fountains of Eternal Life, he led Ka-Sabar's Bronze Host against the army of Bel Aliad loyal to Nagash. After leading his enemy into a trap, Akhmen-hotep's army won the battle and conceded an honorable surrender to Prince Suhedir al-Khazem.

He ended up being betrayed and killed by his brother, Memnet, the Great Hierophant of Ka-Sabar, to ensure himself Nagash's goodwill.
